subject: Request: Git provenance & deployment timeline for SIG assessment
messages:
From: Audit Team <auditteam@fincorps.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Git provenance & deployment timeline for SIG assessment

Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG assessment queue, we need a concise evidence bundle covering Git provenance and deployment chronology for the inference runtime (service: rwi-infer). Specifically we are looking for: 

- PR history with reviewer approvals (last 12 months) and linked CI run IDs
- Signed commits or provenance metadata indicating author/committer identity
- Artifact registry entries with build IDs and checksums
- Deployment changelog (canary -> promote) and who approved each rollout
- CI/CD retention/expiration policies and where logs are stored (and sample excerpts)
- Secrets handling: ephemeral tokens, KMS usage, and rotation cadence (high-level evidence or log excerpts)

We do not need full raw logs for everything, but we do need traces that map a commit -> CI run -> artifact -> deployment (with timestamps) so we can validate the chain of custody. If there are any regulatory constraints around sharing, please flag them up front.

Target: Ideally receive a packaged bundle and a short narrative by EOD Tue Dec 22 (our deadline). If you need more time, please propose.

Regards,
K. Ortiz
Senior IT Auditor
FinCorps Inc.

Attachment: auditor_request_template.pdf (1 page)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Audit Team <auditteam@fincorps.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, david.kim@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Git provenance & deployment timeline for SIG assessment

K.,

Thanks — we can put together a focused package that maps commit -> CI run -> artifact -> deployment for rwi-infer. Plan:

1) We will assemble a zipped package with: PR export (GitHub), signed commit metadata (where available), CI run logs (redacted tokens), artifact registry entries with checksums, and a deployment chronology CSV.
2) Stephanie will provide a short memo on secrets handling and KMS access control.
3) We will include a small excerpt of KMS access logs and the CI retention policy.

We are comfortable sharing these artifacts under NDA; please confirm the recipient list and any additional redaction needs. We’ll aim to deliver a preliminary bundle by Mon Dec 21 and final by EOD Tue Dec 22.

Delivery method: secure Drive link + DocuSign access confirmation (if required).

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: initial_manifest.txt (lists planned files)

Subject: Re: Request: Git provenance & deployment timeline for SIG assessment

Alex/Team,

Thanks — on a couple of specific points we’re hoping you can expand or confirm in the bundle: 

- Commit provenance: do you enforce GPG commit signing or do you rely on metadata from the host (GitHub) such as verified email + commit timestamp? If you have a signed set, please include a sample signed commit and the verification output.
- Artifact registry mapping: we need the build ID and checksum for the canary artifact deployed on 2026-11-15 and the promotion action that moved it to the stable pool. Can you include the registry URL and exact checksum?
- Approvals: who authorized the production promote for that release (name + approver email + timestamp)?
- Rollback proof: provide the canary rollback log (if any) or the deployment history showing no rollback.

If any of the above are stored in separate systems, please point us to the exact log excerpts (or include them). The timeline for those specific items is the critical path for our SIG review.

-K

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Deliverable: SDLC provenance & deployment chronology (rwi-infer)

K., Alex,

Attached is the secure bundle requested for the SIG review. Summary of included artifacts and short answers to the points you highlighted: 

Package: sdlc_git_provenance_package.zip (attached) — contents:
- git_prs_2025-12_to_2026-12.csv (PR export with reviewer list and approval timestamps)
- signed_commit_samples.txt (2 commits with GPG signature blocks and verification output)
- ci_runs/ci_run_2026-11-15.log (CI run output, redacted secrets; includes build ID: bld-20261115-1789)
- artifacts/deployment_audit_2026-11-15.csv (artifact checksum: sha256:3a7f...9c2e, registry: registry.redwood-inference.com/rwi-infer)
- deployment_chronology.csv (rows: commit_hash -> ci_run -> artifact_checksum -> deploy_target -> deploy_time -> approver)
- kms_access_log_excerpt.txt (KMS get/decrypt events for CI service account; timestamps & principal IDs)
- retention_policy.pdf (CI/CD artifact/log retention policy summary)

Short answers (by bullet):
- Commit provenance: We use both verified GitHub push metadata and GPG-signed commits for release branches. The bundle includes two representative signed commits with verification output.
- Artifact mapping: The canary deployed on 2026-11-15 corresponds to build ID bld-20261115-1789 and checksum sha256:3a7f...9c2e hosted at registry.redwood-inference.com/rwi-infer:bld-20261115-1789. See artifacts/deployment_audit_2026-11-15.csv.
- Approvals: Production promote was approved by Catherine Meyer (engineer-on-call) and sign-off in the deployment tool was by Jordan Blake (release manager). Approver emails and timestamps are in deployment_chronology.csv.
- Rollback: No rollback was executed for 2026-11-15; the deployment history shows successful canary health checks and promotion. We included the promotion event and health check summary in the chronology CSV.
- Secrets handling: CI jobs use ephemeral tokens minted via our KMS-backed short-lived credentials broker. The bundle contains a redacted excerpt of the KMS access log and the policy describing rotation cadence (every 24 hours for transient CI tokens).

Notes on sharing: The bundle contains redacted PII and no customer data. If you require raw logs with IP addresses or full principal ARNs, we will need a Data Transfer Agreement addendum.

Next steps: Please confirm receipt and whether the file set satisfies the SIG line items or if you want deeper raw log exports (we can schedule a shared remote session for live review).

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0125

Attachments: sdlc_git_provenance_package.zip (4 items listed), retention_policy.pdf
